features.name: Darkvision
features.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

features.name: Gnomish Cunning
features.description: You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

features.name: Gnomish Lineage
features.description: You have a magical lineage. Choose one of the following options: Forest Gnome, Rock Gnome. You gain the associated benefit. When you finish a Long Rest, you can replace your Lineage with the other option.

choices.name: Gnomish Lineage
choices.description: Forest Gnome: You know the Minor Illusion cantrip; Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it. When you reach character level 3 you learn Speak with Animals as a spell you can cast without material components (once per Long Rest, or with a 1st-level+ slot). Rock Gnome: You know the Mending and Prestidigitation cantrips; Intelligence is your spellcasting ability. As a Bonus Action, you can create a Tiny clockwork device.
